parts.problem_md: Rearrange $y=2x+1$ to make $x$ the subject of the formula.
parts.solution_md:
Subtract 1 from both sides

$y-1=2x$

**[M1]**

Divide both sides by 2

$x=\frac{y-1}{2}\mathrm{or}x=\frac{1}{2}y-\frac{1}{2}$

**[A1]**

parts.problem_md:
Some students dive off boards of different heights.

The speed, $s$ m/s, that they enter the water from a board of height $h$ metres, can be found using this formula.

$s=\sqrt{19.6h}$

i) Calculate the value of $s$ when $h$ = 10.

$s$ = ................................. [2]

ii) Make $h$ the subject of the formula.

$h$ = ................................. [2]
parts.solution_md:
i) *Substitute *$h=10$* into the formula provided and use a calculator to solve  *

$s=\sqrt{19.6\times10}$

**[1]  **

$=\sqrt{196}$

$s=14$ **[1]**

** **

ii) *Square both sides of the formula*

> *  *$s^{2} = ( \sqrt{19.6 \times h} )^{2}$

**[1]***  *

$s^{2}=19.6\timesh$

> *  Divide both sides of the formula by 19.6  *

$h=\frac{s^{2}}{19.6}$** [1]**

> *Add *$3y$* to both sides*

$5x^{2}=4y+8+3y$

> *Simplify*

$5x^{2}=7y+8$

> *Divide both sides by 5*

$x^{2}=\frac{7y+8}{5}$

**[1]**

> *Square-root both sides*

$x=\pm\sqrt{\frac{7y+8}{5}}$** [1]**

> *Subtract *$2p$* from both sides*

$m-2p=\sqrt{\frac{x}{y}}$

**[1]**

> *Square both sides*

$( m - 2 p )^{2} = \frac{x}{y}$

**[1]**

> *Multiply both sides by *$y$

$y ( m - 2 p )^{2} = x$

$x=y(m-2p)^{2}$ **[1]**

**There is no need to expand the bracket**

parts.problem_md:
Make $y$ the subject of the equation $5x-2y+7=0.$

$y=$..........................
parts.solution_md:
> *To isolate *$y$* on one side of the equation, add *$2y$* to both sides*

$5x+7=2y$

**[1]**

> *Divide both sides by 2*

$\frac{5x+7}{2}=y$

$y=\frac{5x+7}{2}$ **[1]**

*Starting by subtracting *$5x$* and 7, and then dividing by -2 would result in *$y=\frac{-5x-7}{-2}$* * *This answer is also equivalent and correct*

parts.problem_md:
Make $r$ the subject of the formula.

$T=3(r+5)$

$r=$ ...............................
parts.solution_md:
> *Divide both sides by 3*

$\frac{T}{3}=r+5$

**[1]**

> *Subtract 5 from both sides*

$\frac{T}{3}-5=r$

$r=\frac{T}{3}-5$ **[1]**

> *Alternatively expand the brackets first and rearrange to obtain *$r=\frac{T-15}{3}$* Both answers are equivalent*

parts.problem_md:
Rearrange the formula $5w--3y+7=0$ to make $w$ the subject.

$w=$..........................
parts.solution_md:
> *To make *$w$* the subject, remove all other terms from the left hand side of the formula*

> *Add *$3y$* to both sides  *

$5w+7=3y$

**[1]**

> *Subtract 7 from both sides  *

$5w=3y-7$

> *Divide each side of the formula by *$5$* to make *$w$* the subject  *

$w=\frac{3y-7}{5}$ **[1]**
